neighbours.label: the name pieces 'beth' and 'cket' (Mac|beth, Liz|beth, Be|cket)
fire: Our drama club staged a modern version of Macbeth set in a factory.
The archbishop Thomas Becket was declared a saint soon after his death.
In the third act, Lady Macbeth begins to walk in her sleep.
Pilgrims travelled to Canterbury to visit the shrine of Becket.
The student essay compared Macbeth with other tragic villains.
My neighbour Lizbeth grows tomatoes on her balcony every summer.
Verdi wrote an opera based on Macbeth in the 1840s.
The film tells the story of Becket and his quarrel with King Henry.
quiet: Our drama club staged a modern version of Othello set in a factory.
The archbishop of Canterbury was declared a saint soon after his death.
In the third act, the queen begins to walk in her sleep.
Pilgrims travelled to Canterbury to visit the shrine of the martyr.
The student essay compared Hamlet with other tragic villains.
My neighbour Martina grows tomatoes on her balcony every summer.
Verdi wrote an opera based on Othello in the 1880s.
The film tells the story of the archbishop and his quarrel with King Henry.
